# Austin Park Dental

> Family and cosmetic dental practice in Barberton, OH serving Summit County with comprehensive preventive care, cosmetic procedures, and advanced diagnostic imaging.

Austin Park Dental is led by Dr. Lynn Herpy and Dr. Bruce Herpy and offers a full range of dental services from routine cleanings and exams to cosmetic dentistry and oral surgery. The practice utilizes advanced technology including i-CAT 3D imaging and CEREC same-day crowns to provide modern, efficient dental care to families in the Barberton and Akron area.

## Key Topics

- Preventive Care
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Dental Imaging
- Oral Cancer Screening

## Preventive Care & Cleanings

- [Cleanings & Prevention](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention): Preventive dental care including cleanings using i-CAT 3D imaging.
- [Dental Exams & Cleanings](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/dental-exams-cleanings): Professional dental exams and cleanings with oral cancer screening.
- [Oral Cancer Exam](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/oral-cancer-exam): Oral cancer screening and early detection examination procedures.
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/fluoride-treatment): Fluoride treatment for tooth decay prevention in children and adults.
- [Home Care](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/home-care): Home oral hygiene care tips and ADA-recommended dental products.
- [How to Properly Brush & Floss](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/how-to-properly-brush-floss): Guide to proper brushing and flossing techniques per ADA standards.

## Dental Imaging & Diagnostics

- [i-CAT® 3D Imaging](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/i-cat-3d-imaging): i-CAT 3D cone beam imaging for implants and oral surgery planning.
- [Digital X-Rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/digital-x-rays): Digital radiography and X-ray technology for dental diagnosis.
- [Dental X-Rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/dental-x-rays): Dental X-ray diagnostic imaging with radiation safety information.
- [Panoramic X-rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/panoramic-x-rays): Panoramic X-ray imaging for wisdom teeth and implant assessment.
- [Cephalometric X-rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/cephalometric-x-rays): Cephalometric X-ray imaging for orthodontic planning and diagnosis.

## Cosmetic Dentistry

- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including whitening, veneers, and bonding.
- [CEREC® Same-Day Crowns](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry/cerec): CEREC CAD-CAM ceramic restorations for same-day dental crowns.
- [Bonding](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry/bonding): Composite resin bonding for smile repair and tooth restoration.
